"""Canonical single-leader Fleet publication; no scheduler or provider starts."""
import importlib.util
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = pathlib.Path('/workspace/work/adopt2121-20261008')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('adapter_common', ROOT / 'publish-consumer-live.py')
common = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(common)
from git_document_store import GitDocumentStore
from git_remote_identity import remote_identity
import fleet_supervisor_control as fleet
import live_target


def main():
    prep = common.read(ROOT / 'fleet-adapter/preparation.json')
    accepted = common.verify_reviews('fleet', prep['candidate'])
    assert 'publish-fleet-live.py' in accepted['operational_source_sha256']
    root = ROOT / 'fleet-publication-adapter'
    import hashlib
    quality = common.read(ROOT / 'fleet-recovery-quality.json')
    assert quality['status'] == 'GREEN' and quality['reviewer'] != 'Cloud implementer'
    assert quality['source_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    request, handle = common.read(root / 'start-request.json'), common.read(root / 'start-receipt.json')
    assert not (root / 'native-publication-receipt.json').exists(), 'Existing submission is observed, never replayed'
    session, runtime, terminal_store = common.bridge._recover_session(request['handle_root'], handle['handle_id'])
    repo = request['repo_root']
    identity = remote_identity(repo, 'origin')
    canonical = GitDocumentStore(repo, 'origin', 'refs/heads/cdc/fleet-supervisor', identity)
    revision, before = canonical.read()
    fleet.validate(before)
    admitted = common.read(root / 'leader-admission-receipt.json')
    owner, generation, invocation = handle['owner_id'], admitted['generation'], handle['invocation_id']
    assert before['lease']['owner_id'] == owner and before['lease']['generation'] == generation
    assert before['lease']['invocation']['invocation_id'] == invocation
    assert before['lease']['external_guard'] is None and before['lease']['finalization']['state'] == 'active'
    assert all(effect['state'] == 'terminal' for effect in before['effects'])
    tr, terminal = terminal_store.read()
    assert terminal['owner_id'] == owner and terminal['generation'] == handle['generation']
    assert terminal['invocation']['invocation_id'] == invocation and terminal['external_guard'] is None
    assert session.get('publication') is None
    intents_probe = GitDocumentStore(repo, 'origin', 'refs/heads/cdc/adopt2121-fleet-live-operation-20261008', identity)
    assert intents_probe.read() == (None, None), 'An existing intent requires reconciliation, never replay'
    common.lease.check_record(before['lease'], owner, generation, invocation, common.now(), action='observe')
    common.lease.check_record(terminal, owner, handle['generation'], invocation, common.now(), action='observe')
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
    while True:
        observation = runtime.observe(request['task_id'], request['attempt_id'])
        if observation['status'] == 'awaiting_release':
            assert observation['pending_terminal_status'] == 'succeeded'
            break
        assert observation['status'] in {'running', 'starting'} and time.monotonic() < deadline
        time.sleep(0.2)
    common.bridge._renew_for_result(session, terminal_store, observation)
    result, paths, _ = common.bridge._result(session, runtime)
    assert result == prep['candidate'] and set(paths) == set(prep['changed_paths'])
    source = live_target.GitSource(repo, 'origin', identity)
    resolved = live_target.resolve_live_target(source, source, registry_ref='refs/heads/cdc/adopt2121-fleet-candidate-20261008', canonical_repository='bajoicheg/g-cdc', target_path='fleet/target.json')
    assert resolved['release']['release_commit'] == '9b38bd4d9f5fb113ec10bdbca9fbe33908619a54'
    assert resolved['release']['evidence_binding']['commit'] == '9dece125d09956d4546721bceb9142856bf786d3'
    binding = {'repository': 'bajoicheg/g-cdc', 'candidate_sha': result, 'backend': 'native_git', 'mode': 'FLEET_ATOMIC_TARGET',
               'environment_id': 'cloud-continuation-a1', 'check_suite_fingerprint': common.operation._hash(accepted),
               'environment_fingerprint': common.operation._hash({'source_identity': identity}), 'check_plan_digest': common.operation._hash(prep)}
    intent = common.operation.prepare(binding, request['attempt_id'] + '-live', request['lease_source_ref'], common.now())
    intents = GitDocumentStore(repo, 'origin', 'refs/heads/cdc/adopt2121-fleet-live-operation-20261008', identity)
    ir, previous = intents.read()
    assert ir is None, 'Unknown submission never replay'
    ir = intents.compare_and_swap(None, intent)
    rr, actual = intents.read()
    assert rr == ir
    receipt = common.operation.verify_readback(intent, actual, 'git:' + ir + ':document.json', common.now())
    intent = common.operation.transition(intent, 'submitting', common.now(), receipt=receipt)
    ir = intents.compare_and_swap(ir, intent)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('budget_update', '/workspace/work/normalize2121-adapter/budget-update.py')
    bu = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(bu)
    wake = 'cloud-adopt2121-20261008'
    event = {'type': 'reserve', 'event_id': 'adopt2121-fleet-live-publication', 'task_id': 'cdc-parallel-maintenance', 'wake_id': wake,
             'at_utc': common.now(), 'kind': 'tool_call', 'operation_key': intent['operation_key'], 'attempt_id': intent['attempt_id'],
             'scope': 'fleet-target/live-publication', 'recovery_ref': None, 'cost': {'tool_calls': 1, 'tokens': None, 'elapsed_seconds': None}}
    budget_revision = bu.update([event], wake, str(root / 'publication-budget.json'))
    lr, record = terminal_store.read()
    lr = terminal_store.compare_and_swap(lr, common.lease.set_guard(record, handle['owner_id'], handle['generation'], handle['invocation_id'], common.now(), intent, 'git:' + ir + ':document.json'))
    common.verify_reviews('fleet', result)
    assert common.git(repo, 'ls-remote', 'origin', request['lease_source_ref']).split()[0] == prep['base']
    assert common.git(repo, 'ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/cdc/parallel-maintenance-budget-20261007').split()[0] == budget_revision
    fresh = live_target.resolve_live_target(source, source, registry_ref='refs/heads/cdc/adopt2121-fleet-candidate-20261008', canonical_repository='bajoicheg/g-cdc', target_path='fleet/target.json')
    assert fresh['registry_revision'] == result
    fr, state = canonical.read()
    effect = fleet.claim_effect_cas(canonical, fr, owner, generation, invocation, common.now(), prep['base'],
                                  {'kind': 'fleet_write', 'target': 'bajoicheg/g-cdc@refs/heads/cdc/fleet', 'observed_fleet_head': prep['base'], 'intent': intent})
    assert effect['action'] == 'SUBMIT_ONCE' and effect['authorizes_effect'] is True
    common.save(root / 'canonical-effect-claim.json', effect)
    lr, record = terminal_store.read()
    common.lease.check_record(record, handle['owner_id'], handle['generation'], handle['invocation_id'], common.now(), action='external_start', intent_digest=common.operation._hash(intent))
    grant = common.lease.claim_submission(terminal_store, lr, request['lease_repository'], request['lease_source_ref'], handle['owner_id'], handle['generation'], handle['invocation_id'], common.now(), intent_digest=common.operation._hash(intent))
    common.save(root / 'terminal-submission-grant.json', grant)
    fr, state = canonical.read()
    fleet.update_effect_cas(canonical, fr, owner, generation, invocation, common.now(), effect['effect']['effect_id'], 'submitted', 'git:' + ir + ':document.json')
    # Released native conditional FF publisher maintains its durable no-replay journal.
    publication = common.bridge._publish(session, result)
    common.save(root / 'native-publication-receipt.json', publication)
    assert publication['conditional_update'] is True
    assert common.git(repo, 'ls-remote', 'origin', request['lease_source_ref']).split()[0] == result
    final_target = live_target.resolve_live_target(source, source, registry_ref=request['lease_source_ref'], canonical_repository='bajoicheg/g-cdc', target_path='fleet/target.json')
    assert final_target['registry_revision'] == result and final_target['target']['target_version'] == '2.12.1'
    common.save(root / 'live-target-readback.json', final_target)
    task = {'task_id': result, 'task_url': 'https://github.com/bajoicheg/g-cdc/tree/' + result, 'operation_key': intent['operation_key'],
            'attempt_id': intent['attempt_id'], 'binding': intent['binding'], 'state': 'terminal', 'conclusion': 'succeeded', 'evidence_refs': [publication['evidence_ref']]}
    observation = {'schema': 'operation-observation/v1', 'operation_key': intent['operation_key'], 'lookup_complete': True, 'observed_at_utc': common.now(), 'tasks': [task]}
    lr, record = terminal_store.read()
    terminal_store.compare_and_swap(lr, common.lease.clear_guard(record, handle['owner_id'], handle['generation'], handle['invocation_id'], common.now(), observation, publication['evidence_ref']))
    ir, actual = intents.read()
    intents.compare_and_swap(ir, common.operation.transition(actual, 'terminal', common.now(), task=task))
    fr, state = canonical.read()
    fleet.update_effect_cas(canonical, fr, owner, generation, invocation, common.now(), effect['effect']['effect_id'], 'terminal', publication['evidence_ref'], outcome='succeeded')
    session.update(state='published', worker_status='succeeded', result_commit=result, publication=publication)
    common.bridge._save_session(session)
    checkpoint = publication['evidence_ref']
    fr, _ = canonical.read()
    fleet.begin_finalization_cas(canonical, fr, owner, generation, invocation, common.now(), pending_shared_writes=False)
    fr, _ = canonical.read()
    fleet.record_checkpoint_cas(canonical, fr, owner, generation, invocation, common.now(), checkpoint_ref=checkpoint)
    fr, _ = canonical.read()
    fleet.reconcile_finalization_cas(canonical, fr, owner, generation, invocation, common.now(), external_reconciliation='none')
    continuity = common.bridge._continuity(session, result, checkpoint, publication, released=False)
    continuity['invocation_id'] = invocation
    continuity['terminal_state']['invocation_id'] = invocation
    fr, _ = canonical.read()
    fleet.mark_ready_cas(canonical, fr, owner, generation, invocation, common.now(), continuity_state=continuity)
    fr, _ = canonical.read()
    released = fleet.release_leader_cas(canonical, fr, owner, generation, invocation, common.now())
    common.save(root / 'canonical-leader-release.json', released)
    task_plan = request['plan']['tasks'][0]
    finish = {'schema': 'managed-host-finish/v1', 'handle_root': request['handle_root'], 'handle_id': handle['handle_id'],
              'output_refs': task_plan['expected_outputs'], 'evidence_refs': task_plan['expected_evidence'], 'checkpoint_ref': checkpoint}
    finished = common.bridge.finish(finish)
    common.save(root / 'finish-receipt.json', finished)
    assert finished['scope_complete'] and finished['state'] == 'released'
    terminal = runtime.observe(request['task_id'], request['attempt_id'])
    common.save(root / 'supervisor-terminal.json', terminal)
    assert terminal['quiescent'] is True
    fr, state = canonical.read()
    assert state['lease']['owner_id'] is None and state['lease']['external_guard'] is None
    print(json.dumps({'candidate': result, 'canonical_release_revision': fr, 'managed_finish': finished}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

def sanitize(value):
 value=re.sub(r'https://[^/@\s]+@','https://[redacted]@',value)
 value=re.sub(r'(?:gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]+|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]+)','[redacted]',value)
 return re.sub(r'\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b','[redacted-IP]',value)
class DiagnosticGitSource(live_target.GitSource):
 def _git(self,*args,allow_nonancestor=False):
  argv=['git','-C',str(self.repo),*args];start=c.now()
  try:
   result=subprocess.run(argv,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                         env=git_object_environment(GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0'),timeout=30)
  except (OSError,subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
   rows.append({'argv':argv,'at_utc':start,'exit_code':None,'exception':type(error).__name__});raise ValueError('Git source transport unavailable') from None
  rows.append({'argv':argv,'at_utc':start,'exit_code':result.returncode,'stderr':sanitize(result.stderr),
               'stdout_utf8_bytes':len(result.stdout.encode())})
  if result.returncode and not (allow_nonancestor and result.returncode==1):raise ValueError('Git source operation failed')
  return result.returncode,result.stdout.rstrip('\n')

except Exception as error:

"""Read authenticated Git facts; no publication, scheduler or product effects."""
import datetime
import importlib.util
import json
import pathlib
import tempfile

ROOT = pathlib.Path('/workspace/work/adopt2121-20261008')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('common', ROOT / 'publish-consumer-live.py')
common = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(common)
from contracts import load_yaml
from consumer_lock import validate as validate_lock
from validate_adapter import validate_adapter
from validate_checkpoint_24 import validate_checkpoint_24
from convergence_vector import normalize
from fleet_supervisor import validate_snapshot
from progress_slo import validate_observation
from git_lease_store import GitLeaseStore


def facts(name, watchdog):
    request = common.read(ROOT / (name + '-adapter/start-request.json'))
    prep = common.read(ROOT / (name + '-adapter/preparation.json'))
    repo, ref = request['repo_root'], request['lease_source_ref']
    head = common.git(repo, 'ls-remote', 'origin', ref).split()[0]
    assert head == prep['candidate'], 'Source changed; replan, never overwrite'
    common.git(repo, 'fetch', '--no-tags', 'origin', ref)
    package = common.git(repo, 'rev-parse', head + ':.agents/skills/continuous-development-cycle')
    assert package == '9c45d98c3254e9658d452c505d8c97698e3fc9a7'
    count = len(common.git(repo, 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', package).splitlines())
    assert count == 352
    lock = json.loads(common.git(repo, 'show', head + ':docs/cdc-consumer-lock.json'))
    validate_lock(lock)
    assert lock['release_commit'] == '9b38bd4d9f5fb113ec10bdbca9fbe33908619a54'
    assert lock['version'] == '2.12.1' and lock['package_tree'] == package
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=ROOT) as directory:
        p = pathlib.Path(directory)
        for path, filename in [('docs/development-cycle.yaml', 'adapter.yaml'), ('docs/work-status/current.md', 'checkpoint.md')]:
            (p / filename).write_text(common.git(repo, 'show', head + ':' + path) + '\n')
        adapter = load_yaml(p / 'adapter.yaml')
        checkpoint = load_yaml(p / 'checkpoint.md', frontmatter=True)
        binding = validate_adapter(adapter, '2.12.1')
        validate_checkpoint_24(checkpoint, adapter)
    store = GitLeaseStore(repo, 'origin', 'refs/heads/cdc/coordination')
    revision, lease = store.read()
    assert lease['owner_id'] is None and lease['external_guard'] is None and lease['finalization'] is None
    assert lease['last_release']['completion_reason'] == 'scope_complete'
    now = common.now()
    observed = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(watchdog['observed_at_utc'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
    assert 0 <= (datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) - observed).total_seconds() <= 300
    assert watchdog['repository'] == request['lease_repository'] and watchdog['source_ref'] == ref
    assert watchdog['is_enabled'] is False and watchdog['source'] == 'actual automations.peek receipt'
    progress = {'schema': 'progress-observation/v1', 'observed_at_utc': now,
                'last_meaningful_progress_at_utc': None,
                'last_activity_at_utc': checkpoint['observed_at_utc'],
                'primitive_steps_since_progress': checkpoint['execution_continuity']['primitive_steps_since_progress'],
                'blocker': checkpoint['blocker'].strip().lower() not in {'none', 'no blocker', 'n/a', '-', ''},
                'waiting_external': checkpoint['waiting_external_kind'] is not None,
                'phase': checkpoint['phase'], 'evidence_refs': ['git:' + head + ':docs/work-status/current.md']}
    validate_observation(progress)
    snapshot = {'schema': 'fleet-project-snapshot/v1', 'repository': request['lease_repository'], 'source_ref': ref,
                'observed_at_utc': now, 'product_head': head, 'cdc_version': '2.12.1',
                'package_fingerprint': 'git-tree:' + package, 'checkpoint_schema': checkpoint['schema'],
                'policy_revision': binding['policy_revision'],
                'watchdog': {'enabled': False, 'last_run_at_utc': watchdog['last_run_at_utc']},
                'coordination': {'lease_schema': lease['schema'], 'generation': lease['generation'], 'owner_active': False, 'guard_present': False},
                'progress': progress}
    validate_snapshot(snapshot)
    digest = 'sha256:' + binding['policy_digest']
    convergence = {'schema': 'cdc-convergence-observation/v1', 'repository': request['lease_repository'],
                   'source_ref': ref, 'source_head': head, 'cdc_version': '2.12.1', 'package_tree': package,
                   'consumer_lock': {k: lock[k] for k in ['version', 'release_commit', 'package_tree']},
                   'policy_digest': digest,
                   'checkpoint': {'valid': True, 'source_head': head, 'policy_digest': digest},
                   'lease': {'state': 'released'}, 'guard': {'state': 'none'}, 'adoption_state': 'integrated'}
    vector = normalize(convergence)
    assert vector['adoption_state'] == 'integrated'
    return {'snapshot': snapshot, 'convergence_observation': convergence, 'convergence_vector': vector,
            'source_head': head, 'coordination_revision': revision, 'lease': lease, 'consumer_lock': lock,
            'checkpoint_blob': common.git(repo, 'rev-parse', head + ':docs/work-status/current.md'),
            'checkpoint_git_binding_explanation': 'source_head is the actual Git object containing the validated checkpoint, not a rewritten product implementation/candidate SHA',
            'product_checkpoint': checkpoint,
            'meaningful_progress_time_provenance': 'unknown; process adoption does not fabricate product progress',
            'watchdog_receipt': watchdog}
